topic: How to win the first three seconds of a Reel
title: Win the first 3 seconds
angle: Every creator struggles with drop-off; a quick, usable checklist.
caption:
Your reel is decided before most people even hear the second sentence.

Open with the payoff.
Put the words on screen.
Move in the very first frame.

Which of these are you skipping right now?
factCheck: Sample script for testing the template; contains advice, no statistics.

scenes.voiceover: Your reel lives or dies in the first three seconds. Here's how to win them.
scenes.headline: Your reel dies in 3 seconds

scenes.voiceover: One. Open with the payoff. Show the result first, and explain it later.
scenes.headline: Open with the payoff

scenes.voiceover: Two. Put the words on screen, because plenty of people watch on mute.
scenes.headline: Put the words on screen
scenes.body: Plenty of people watch on mute.

scenes.voiceover: Think of it as a three second window. Every frame has to earn the next one.
scenes.headline: A three second window

scenes.voiceover: Before you post, check three things: a bold first line, movement in the first frame, and captions from the start.
scenes.headline: The 3-second checklist

scenes.voiceover: Follow for a new reel tip every single day.
scenes.headline: Want a tip every day?
